confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from one search that showed the 18 November 2026 observation, the latest available. Food and drink anchors come from one search of crowdsourced cost-of-living sites. Those sites varied by source and update date, and I did not open the pages. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price, since I found no direct data. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. Hostel and hotel prices are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kaohsiung is priced like other mid-sized Taiwanese cities and sits slightly below Taipei. Estimates draw on cost-of-living index data for Kaohsiung, with Taipei and Taichung as a loose reference.
